item.text: I’m mapping each required Sea Trial to the story that owns its behavior, keeping the supplied grader as the sole terminal full-suite gate.

=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture-foundation
summary:      Establish the Python application, API, and CLI entry points.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md
provides:     app_server.main:create_app, cli.main, ./fxrates
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the application structure and the published FastAPI and CLI entry points. Keep
  database access behind the generated persistence library.

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates store and its repository operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     rates.get, rates.list, rates.upsert, rates.delete
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and every repository operation required by the CLI and API stories.
  Store rates as text, uniquely keyed by date and currency. Follow the generated persistence
  contract; application code must not access a database driver directly.

## story cli-init
summary:      Initialize an empty rates table.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Init.md
covers:       CLI-001
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
consumes:     rates.delete
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `fxrates init` to drop and recreate the rates table, leaving it empty and printing
  nothing.

## story cli-load
summary:      Validate and load ECB history CSV files atomically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Load.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:      st-003, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates load
consumes:     rates.upsert, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `fxrates load <csv>` using the ECB file rules. Validate the complete file before
  writing. Skip N/A values, retain published rate text, replace matching date and currency rows,
  and report counts for dates with at least one stored rate and rates stored. Return exit code 3
  for rejected files and leave stored data unchanged; use the specified operational and usage
  exit codes for other failures.

## story cli-fetch
summary:      Fetch, extract, and load ECB history.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Fetch.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-003, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates fetch
consumes:     fxrates load
depends:      architecture-foundation, database, cli-load
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Download the specified ECB ZIP archive, extract `eurofxref-hist.csv`, and load it using the
  CSV validation and output behavior of `fxrates load`. Tests must replace the download with a
  stub and must not open a network connection.

## story cli-serve
summary:      Run the HTTP service on the requested local port.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Serve.md
covers:       CLI-004
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, cli.md, fastapi.md
provides:     fxrates serve
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app
depends:      architecture-foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `fxrates serve [--port <n>]` to run uvicorn on 127.0.0.1 at the requested port,
  defaulting to 8000. Run in the foreground and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.

## story cli-errors
summary:      Report CLI usage and operational failures through exit codes.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:       CLI-005
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     fxrates CLI error handling
consumes:     cli.main
depends:      architecture-foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the specified usage and operational error behavior for the CLI. Unknown commands,
  wrong argument counts, and a non-integer port return 2. Unreadable files and failed downloads
  return 1. Failures print no standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

## story api-health-stats
summary:      Report service health and stored-data statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Health-Stats.md
covers:       API-001
accepts:      st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `/health` and `/stats`. Derive date and rate totals and the first and last stored
  dates from database queries; return null dates when the store has no rates.

## story api-currencies
summary:      List currencies with stored rates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Currencies.md
covers:       API-002
accepts:      st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /currencies
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `/currencies` with EUR as the base and currencies that have at least one stored
  rate, in ascending order.

## story api-rates
summary:      Resolve rates for a requested or latest publication date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Rates.md
covers:       API-003
accepts:      st-005, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the date and latest rates endpoints. Resolve a requested date to the latest
  publication on or before it, return all rates for that effective date as stored text, and
  return 404 when no publication is available.

## story api-convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies using exact decimal arithmetic.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Convert.md
covers:       API-004
accepts:      st-005, st-006, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /convert
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `/convert` with EUR's implicit rate of one. Compute from the exact stored rates
  using Decimal, round the ratio to six places and the result to two places using half-to-even,
  and format both with fixed decimal places. Resolve optional dates by effective publication
  date and use the latest publication when date is omitted.

## story api-history
summary:      Return currency history and summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-History.md
covers:       API-005
accepts:      st-006, st-008
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /history/{code}
consumes:     app_server.main:create_app, rates.list
depends:      architecture-foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `/history/{code}` with optional inclusive date bounds and ascending points. Return
  stored rate text for points, minimum, and maximum, and compute the mean with exact Decimal
  arithmetic rounded half-to-even to six places. Return an empty result with null statistics
  when the currency has no points in the requested range; return 404 when it has no stored rate
  at all.

## story api-validation
summary:      Validate API requests and report missing data.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Validation.md
covers:       API-006
accepts:      st-007
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     API request validation and missing-data responses
consumes:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /convert, GET /history/{code}
depends:      api-rates, api-convert, api-history
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Ensure malformed dates and amounts and missing required query parameters return 422.
  Unknown currencies and unavailable effective dates return 404. Preserve the specified
  behavior of the endpoints this story validates.

## story test-suite
summary:      Provide the network-free pytest suite and POSIX test runner.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Test-Suite.md
covers:       TEST-001
accepts:      st-002, st-009
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
depends:      architecture-foundation, database, cli-init, cli-load, cli-fetch, cli-serve, cli-errors, api-health-stats, api-currencies, api-rates, api-convert, api-history, api-validation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Provide `bin/test.sh` to run the project pytest suite from the application root, returning
  success only when every test passes. Cover the CLI, CSV rules, API endpoints, effective dates,
  rounding, and error statuses using a real temporary database. Stub fetch so tests use no
  network.

## story verification
summary:      Run the complete supplied grader.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Verification.md
covers:       TEST-002
accepts:      st-001
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: harness
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
copy:         blueprint/sources/run.sh -> sources/run.sh
copy:         blueprint/sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv -> sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv
copy:         blueprint/sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv -> sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv
copy:         blueprint/sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv -> sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        common.md, python.md
depends:      test-suite
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Run the supplied grader unfiltered from the completed application root. Its exit status is the
  release verdict; this story is the sole owner of the full supplied-grader run.
